zh.name: 圣临庇世
zh.description: 贞德召唤圣光降临，使自身与【圣旗】周围的单位获得<color=#02ff00>2</color>秒无敌效果，无敌效果消失时获得贞德<color=#02ff00>20%</color>最大生命值的护盾

upgrades.zh: 等级2：无敌效果消失时获得贞德<color=#02ff00>25%</color>最大生命值的护盾
upgrades.en: When the invincibility ends, they gain a shield equal to 25% of Joanne's Max HP.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：无敌效果消失时<color=#02ff00>6</color>秒内受到伤害降低<color=#02ff00>30%</color>
upgrades.en: When the invincibility ends, damage taken is reduced by 30% for 6s.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：无敌效果消失时获得贞德<color=#02ff00>30%</color>最大生命值的护盾
upgrades.en: When the invincibility ends, they gain a shield equal to 30% of Joanne's Max HP.

en.name: Holy Descent
en.description: Joanne calls down holy light, granting herself and units around the [Holy Banner] invincibility for 2s. When the invincibility ends, they gain a shield equal to 20% of Joanne's Max HP.

zh.name: 圣旗守望
zh.description:
战斗开始时，贞德在友方战场中心召唤【圣旗】，【圣旗】存在时为周围<color=#02ff00>4</color>米范围友军提升<color=#02ff00>10%</color>伤害减免和<color=#02ff00>10%</color>能量恢复速度
主动释放时，贞德对周围敌人造成<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力伤害，同时使【圣旗】范围内友军提升<color=#02ff00>30%</color>攻击力，持续<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒

upgrades.zh: 等级2：造成伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>250%</color>攻击力
等级3：【圣旗】存在时为周围<color=#02ff00>4</color>米范围友军提升<color=#02ff00>15%</color>伤害减免和<color=#02ff00>15%</color>能量恢复速度
upgrades.en: While the [Holy Banner] stands, allies within 4m gain 15% damage reduction and 15% Energy regeneration speed.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：主动释放时使【圣旗】范围内友军提升<color=#02ff00>40%</color>攻击力，持续<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒
upgrades.en: When actively cast, allies within the [Holy Banner]'s range gain 40% ATK for 8s.

en.name: Banner Watch
en.description:
At the start of battle, Joanne summons the [Holy Banner] at the center of the allied battlefield. While it stands, allies within 4m gain 10% damage reduction and 10% Energy regeneration speed.
When actively cast, Joanne deals 200% ATK as DMG to surrounding enemies, and allies within the [Holy Banner]'s range gain 30% ATK for 8s.

zh.name: 信仰共鸣
zh.description: 【圣旗】范围内每有一名友军，贞德获得一层"信仰"（信仰：每层信仰使贞德受到伤害降低<color=#02ff00>9%</color>，造成的治疗和护盾效果提升<color=#02ff00>10%</color>）

upgrades.zh: 等级2：每层"信仰"使贞德受到伤害降低<color=#02ff00>13%</color>
upgrades.en: Each stack of "Faith" reduces damage Joanne takes by 13%.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：每层"信仰"使贞德造成的治疗和护盾效果提升<color=#02ff00>15%</color>
upgrades.en: Each stack of "Faith" increases the healing and shields Joanne provides by 15%.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：每层"信仰"使贞德受到伤害降低<color=#02ff00>17%</color>
upgrades.en: Each stack of "Faith" reduces damage Joanne takes by 17%.

en.name: Resonance of Faith
en.description: For each ally within the [Holy Banner]'s range, Joanne gains 1 stack of "Faith" (Faith: each stack reduces damage Joanne takes by 9% and increases the healing and shields she provides by 10%).

zh.name: 圣光祷愈
zh.description: 为自身恢复<color=#02ff00>10%</color>最大生命值，【圣旗】范围内每有一名友军额外触发一次，【圣旗】范围内队友获得自身受到的治疗量的<color=#02ff00>50%</color>

upgrades.zh: 等级2：为自身恢复<color=#02ff00>15%</color>最大生命值
upgrades.en: Restores 15% of her own Max HP.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：【圣旗】范围内队友获得自身受到的治疗量的<color=#02ff00>70%</color>
upgrades.en: Allies within the [Holy Banner]'s range receive 70% of the healing Joanne receives.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：为自身恢复<color=#02ff00>20%</color>最大生命值
upgrades.en: Restores 20% of her own Max HP.

en.name: Prayer of Radiant Healing
en.description: Restores 10% of her own Max HP. For each ally within the [Holy Banner]'s range, this triggers once more, and allies within the [Holy Banner]'s range receive 50% of the healing Joanne receives.

levels.zh: 贞德释放终结技时将强化【圣旗】，使【圣旗】范围内的友方单位获得<color=#02ff00>20%</color>会心率和会心伤害，持续<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒
levels.en: When Joanne casts her ultimate, she empowers the [Holy Banner]: allies within its range gain 20% Crit Rate and Crit DMG for 8s.

levels.zh: 【圣旗】范围内的友方单位额外获得<color=#02ff00>10%</color>伤害减免
levels.en: Allies within the [Holy Banner]'s range gain an additional 10% damage reduction.

levels.zh: 贞德释放终结技时将强化【圣旗】，使【圣旗】范围内的友方单位获得<color=#02ff00>30%</color>会心率和会心伤害，持续<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒
levels.en: When Joanne casts her ultimate, she empowers the [Holy Banner]: allies within its range gain 30% Crit Rate and Crit DMG for 8s.

levels.zh: 终结技无敌效果时间额外提升<color=#02ff00>1</color>秒
levels.en: The invincibility from her ultimate lasts 1s longer.
